# T-1: Classify retry exhaustion

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Introduce or refine a structured classification boundary that separates AI semantic retry exhaustion from non-semantic tooling, schema, command, test evidence, no-progress, and flow-state failures.

## Acceptance Criteria
- R3 prose words in AI findings do not reject semantic deferral.
- R4 structured non-semantic fields remain blocking and are not deferred.
- R4 test-review coverage/header failures are classified from test-coverage.json validation or equivalent structured origin/failureKind data.
- The classification is shared by review/gate/test-review paths rather than duplicated as separate regex lists.

## Implementation Notes
Prefer a class-based value if new classification data carries invariants or behavior. Existing helpers in run-review.js, run-gate.js, flow-findings.js, and flow-judgment-contract.js should converge on the same boundary.

## Test Strategy
Unit tests for semantic findings that contain test/missing/invalid/schema/command words, plus structured toolingFailure, command exit, invalid schema, failed test evidence, no-progress, and flow-state failure cases.
